reflection_candidates: Stayed patient waiting for confirmation instead of chasing early entries.

The week's real lesson was about sizing, not direction: the biggest drawdown came from a correctly-called trade held far past the plan's target because conviction crept up mid-position, and the recovery only started once every entry went back to being sized off the written risk plan rather than off how confident the setup felt in the moment.
Cut a losing trade early on Wednesday and it saved the week.

spec.headline: Week in review
spec.subhead: Steady grind, discipline held through the chop
